All the key moments from a high-scoring contest in the opening clash of the India leg of the FIH Pro League 2025–26, as Belgium delivered a commanding performance against Argentina at the Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium, Rourkela.
From rapid transitions and clinical penalty corner conversions to decisive field goals, the match showcased elite international hockey at its finest. Belgium capitalised on crucial moments to outplay Argentina in a game defined by intensity, precision and attacking flair.
Relive every goal, save and turning point from an electrifying evening in Odisha.
